selection_rule: Lowest validation outcome log loss among entries with goal predictions; no test-based reselection.

feature_schema.target_definition: Recorded final score, including extra time, excluding penalty shoot-outs
feature_schema.missing_values: Blank means unavailable. Fit any imputer and scaler on training rows only.
feature_schema.elo_expected_score_definition: Expected win/draw/loss score with win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0; not a home-win probability.
feature_schema.window_definition: Uses up to the specified number of prior appearances; an empty history is unavailable, not zero.
feature_schema.history_initialization: Begins at the first prepared match; no pre-1990 results are used by default.
feature_schema.same_date_policy: All features use strictly earlier calendar dates. All same-date ratings use the common pre-date state.
feature_schema.within_date_history_order: Deterministic match-ID order for subsequent rolling windows; kickoff order is unavailable.
feature_schema.evaluation_mode: Sequential forecasts: earlier validation/test results may update history before later fixtures. Model fitting remains restricted to the designated fitting period.
feature_schema.defaults_note: Engineering defaults fixed before model evaluation; tune using training/validation only.
feature_schema.is_friendly_definition: Tournament field equals Friendly, ignoring case.

refitting_rule: Clone the selected training-only estimators with unchanged hyperparameters; fit on train plus validation.
